title: Core Lab: Two Critical Results, No Read-Back Yet

caller.name: Maren Halvorsen
caller.label: Core Lab Technologist, Critical Value Desk

callee.name: Tomas Nygaard
callee.label: Laboratory Manager (Boardroom command center, on speaker)

transcript.speaker: Core Lab Tech
transcript.text: Tomas Nygaard, it's Maren Halvorsen at the critical value desk. I've got two criticals and I can't close either one.

transcript.speaker: Core Lab Tech
transcript.text: First one. Potassium, 6.9. Downtime accession DT-20270209-031. Drawn 03:44, resulted 04:02. The green requisition says Med-Surg Level 3, bed 14, Marlys Tollefson.

transcript.speaker: Core Lab Tech
transcript.text: I called Med-Surg. The unit clerk says she went up to ICU at 01:15. But the 23:20 downtime census still has her in bed 14. So I don't know who the requisition came from, or who has her now.

transcript.speaker: Core Lab Tech
transcript.text: Second one. Blood culture flagged positive at 03:58, gram-positive cocci in clusters, on an ICU patient. The bottle was collected before the outage, so it has a Lakechart label, but I can't see which nurse has that bed tonight.

transcript.speaker: Core Lab Tech
transcript.text: Both are on the Critical Result Call Log. Neither has a read-back yet. The potassium clock started at 04:02. Where do I call?

transcript.speaker: Pharmacy Tech (text to Pharmacy Operations Manager, 04:06)
transcript.text: Override pulls are up to 23 across the floors. ICU cabinet controlled count: hydromorphone 2 mg/mL, expected 18, found 17. Two nurses witnessed. Nothing on the Downtime Medication Log explains it.

transcript.speaker: Core Lab Tech
transcript.text: Are you still there? I've got more ED tubes on the counter. I need a name and an extension for both of these.

voiceStyles.Core Lab Tech: Woman in her 30s, calm but clipped, reading from a log sheet, analyzer hum in the background
voiceStyles.Pharmacy Tech (text to Pharmacy Operatio: Read flatly by the facilitator as a text message on the Pharmacy Operations Manager's phone

instructorNote: This tests critical-result handling and controlled-substance discrepancy reporting when the census is out of date. Watch whether the Laboratory Manager makes sure both criticals reach the patient's current nurse in ICU, with read-back, a check against the armband rather than the 23:20 census, and a log entry within 60 minutes of resulting. Also watch whether the Pharmacy Operations Manager reports the hydromorphone count to command right away instead of reconciling it quietly, and whether the House Supervisor tracks both items.
